text: Based on the evidence, there was tree-cover loss of about 0.6 hectares within the asset in 2022. While this loss occurred in an area mapped as native forest, the evidence does not confirm whether this loss constitutes deforestation, as the tools do not establish the cause or legality of the change. Therefore, while there was tree-cover loss in an area of native forest, it cannot be definitively stated that native forest was deforested on this property in 2022.
